items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And after Joe Sullivan came in they wanted me. So this is pre-Napoleon. >> [INTERVIEWER] Marty Napoleon. [INTERVIEWEE] Martin Napoleon. This was pre-Marty --

ctx.x: And I have to think that I have Barney Bigard to thank for it. And the band -- whoever -- Frenchie, Frenchie looked at me and says, you belong in that scene. See, Earl had left, and before Joe Sullivan came in, they wanted me. And after Joe Sullivan came in they wanted me. So this is pre-Napoleon.
